transcript.content: I want to learn Japanese so I can travel more confidently and understand anime without subtitles someday.
Excellent quest. What would a clear first victory look like for your Japanese Adventure?
In a year I want to handle basic travel conversations, read kana comfortably, and understand simple listening practice. I know hiragana and a few phrases.
You have the first runes on the map. What time, tools, or study resources do you already have available?
I can study 25 minutes most mornings. I have Genki 1, Anki, headphones, and a language exchange app, but I have not found a consistent speaking partner.
